notes.title: 1 year Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
Patch notes :
Menu bars for sensitivity, fov, and max fps now have numbers next to their label to tell you their amounts.
Adjusted Killer's POV police map for better Survivor AI navigation
Added a new map for Killer's POV the Junkyard!

Hello everyone! It has been one year since launching American Eristics! Thanks for the support, videos, and love you've shown this game. This was the first time I was very honest about my fears and put them into my work. It coincided with me releasing it while moving back to my hometown. I had a lot of the same fears Andrea had. I even had a scary movie night with my friends when I got back. There were so many art imitating life imitating art moments while making this game. I wouldn't have had it any other way. I released another horror game this year. This time a Resident Evil style third person shooter in my 2.5D style. If you're curious give it a shot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771550
